summary: The change excludes the current capture link from the hover marker rule, refreshes the stylesheet content token, and adds a focused regression test; no defects found.

evidence: At base, the hover rule in `public/detail.css` matched every timeline item and came later with equal specificity, so it replaced the selected marker, matching the reported defect.

The candidate hover selector at `public/detail.css:160` adds `[data-capture-timeline-link]:not([aria-current])` so the selected link no longer matches and keeps the 40px foreground marker from the active rule at line 139.
Non-selected entries still match the item hover rule and receive the 24px muted marker; the item-level preview hover behavior is unchanged.
`tests/capture-timeline-styles.test.ts` asserts the active marker declarations and the current-excluding hover selector, and the repository test command `bun test tests` includes the new file.
